We’re a team of creative and passionate roboticists. Together with our partners, we want to make robotic manufacturing accessible to every company.
Read about our partners
Partners | Adaxis
Partners
PARTNERS
We foster innovation through close collaboration with our partners. Our vision is to scale additive manufacturing and unleash its worldwide potential.
RESELLER / INTEGRATOR | Exeter, UK
How can I become a partner?

Becoming an ADAXIS partner means more than just reselling—it’s about empowering clients with cutting-edge solutions while enjoying seamless operational freedom. Our partnership model allows you to deploy our technology effortlessly while ensuring a streamlined experience for end-users.

Success as an ADAXIS partner requires deep expertise in our software and technologies to guarantee an outstanding customer experience. Depending on your commitment and capabilities, we tailor the right partnership program—whether Light or Premium. Let’s explore the possibilities together.

We make it easy for partners to embed AdaOne licenses directly into their offerings while providing top-tier client support. Specific terms and conditions apply, ensuring a frictionless experience for all stakeholders.
Partners
Partners

The easiest way is to email us or book a demo session. In just 45 minutes, we’ll guide you through a live, interactive demo of AdaOne, ensuring it meets your needs. If you prefer, you can also reach out to one of our certified partners, who will be happy to assist you.
If you prefer, you can also subscribe through our certified partners, which is often recommended for existing agreements or bundled purchases like machines, tools, and integrations.
If you purchase through a certified partner, you will receive the invoice from them, and they will handle everything for you.
How can I become an ADAXIS partner?

If you are passionate about manufacturing and innovation, we’d love to hear from you! We are always looking for strong partners to expand our ecosystem. If you’re interested in bundling AdaOne with your offer, contact us at info@adaxis.eu to start the conversation. Check our

Every AdaOne subscriber gets a dedicated expert (the same throughout the subscription) who specializes in your needs. We prioritize support via video calls and email, with direct access to the expert’s calendar for scheduling assistance. Support is available in English, French, German, and Spanish, while our partners can also assist in Hindi, Korean, Japanese, and Arabic.
Is there any difference buying from ADAXIS or a partner?

No, the AdaOne software is the same whether you purchase it directly from us or through a partner. If you buy through a certified partner, they will be your first point of contact for support, while ADAXIS remains available as a secondary resource if needed. Our partners are experts in AdaOne and provide high-quality assistance.
